name: Kin-trees
description: Abzan sacred plants, half living wood and half golden spirit, that bind the clan to its ancestors.

description_citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Daghatar orders every kin-tree uprooted and necromancy forbidden, and Dromoka nods; Merel warns of civil war.
timeline.quote: Uproot every kin-tree. The practice of necromancy is hereby forbidden.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's law outlaws ancestor magic as necromancy, and a few renegade spirit speakers hide kin-trees.
timeline.quote: Ancestor magic, once practiced by the distant forebears of the modern-day Dromoka humanoids, is outlawed by the dragonlord as a form of necromancy.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed for kin-tree worship, but a ghostly figure like her is seen fighting alongside the Dromoka.
timeline.quote: However, she practiced ancient kin-tree worship, and for that she was executed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

pages_say.description: Abzan ancestor-trees bound with the spirits of the dead, which Daghatar orders uprooted.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

pages_say.description: Secret trees holding ancestors' souls, worshipped by Dromoka spirit speakers despite the ban.
